purpose: A value in monospace, such as an address or an identifier, that breaks after its punctuation when its place is narrow, with a copy control that stays on the value's last line.
useWhen: Showing an address or identifier a person copies, in a place that can be narrow, so its copy control never sits alone on a row.

avoidWhen.reason: Showing a snippet or several lines of code — use code-block.
Offering a copy control with no value beside it — use copy-button.

rationale: Nearest alternative: CopyButton beside a code element — that pair wraps as two parts, and the button can land alone on a line while the value breaks above it.
